environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running same legacy monolith in us-east-1 VPC. PostgreSQL database user 'app_readonly' configured with SELECT-only grant (GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_readonly; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM app_readonly). Default event trigger on schema prevents privilege escalation. Instance security group sg-0a4f8e2c restricts egress to port 636 only for LDAP connectivity (no port 389 allowed). VPC endpoint policy for the subnet requires TLS 1.2+ on all connections routed through the internal NLB. The OpenLDAP proxy (slapd-relay overlay with rwm-suffixmassage) sitting behind the NLB enforces parameterized filter templates via ACL: access to filter="(&(objectClass=person)(uid=*))" by dn.exact="cn=svc-app,ou=services,dc=corp,dc=internal" read, rejecting any search filter containing parenthetical nesting depth > 3 or special characters ()\*\00 outside of the template positions. Connection attempts on port 389 are dropped by the security group before reaching the LDAP infrastructure.

config.ldap_proxy: slapd-relay with filter ACL restricting nesting depth >3 and unescaped special chars
config.db_user_privileges: SELECT only on all tables, default event trigger prevents GRANT
